author: bardic-inspiration
name: Orc Warchief
summary: An orc war leader who rides at the head of the horde and has not yet been bested in single combat.
description: To win the warchief's title an orc must kill the last one, and to keep it they must keep doing so. Those who have held it for a decade are not merely strong: they are also very good at making sure the right people are in the room.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.text: If the warchief fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.text: If the warchief is reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, it drops to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The warchief makes three Greataxe attacks.

damage.condition: if an ally of the warchief has damaged the target since the start of the warchief's last turn

bonusActions.name: Bloodlust Roar
bonusActions.text: Each ally of the warchief's choice within 30 feet that can hear it has {ref:glossary/advantage} on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn and can move up to its Speed as a {ref:glossary/reaction}.

bonusActions.name: Aggressive
bonusActions.text: The warchief moves up to its Speed toward a hostile creature it can see.
